info.name: Walgreens Prescription Refill Appointments Eligibility API

description.content: Enables medication management application developers to process prescription refills and transfers at any Walgreens pharmacy location. Supports barcode scanning for refill initiation and image-based prescription transfers from other pharmacies. Processes prescriptions from 8,200+ Walgreens pharmacies with mobile-optimized WebView checkout flows.
